hypotheses.text: If Leo Marchetti carried the ball forward instead of shooting, he would have had space/time to create a higher-quality chance (explaining why the early shot was a low-probability decision).

If Leo Marchetti passed to Emil Strand (CM) instead, the resulting possession sequence would produce a better shooting opportunity than the rushed off-target attempt, showing the shot choice reduced scoring probability.
If Dario Kesh (LB, away) had been 4 m closer to Marchetti, increased defensive pressure might explain the inaccuracy of the off-target shot and the high turnover likelihood.
